title: A fresh question changes the foundation
meaning: A fresh question can free your shared view from an untested foundation and bring an important new understanding.
text: Sometimes an almost naive question helps you understand a shared endeavour. The Fool in the physical position of Ajna suggests exploring without a ready answer, trying a fresh entry point and feeling free to lack knowledge. The Tower in energy directs you constructively towards releasing false foundations, seeing which assumption no longer withstands examination. Judgement in emotions experiences this as awakening: something you both kept passing over suddenly becomes understandable. The discovery's importance does not depend on how serious the first question sounded.

Suppose you cannot find time for a shared idea although both of you have free hours. Asking “Are we talking about the same hours?” changes the picture. **A new question helps reveal a foundation you had not checked.** Comparing timetables can uncover a simple mismatch, allowing you to stop explaining everything through a lack of interest. Available overlapping time becomes the subject, replacing an invisible cause you were taking turns trying to guess.

The difficulty is becoming so excited by discovery that you immediately question every previous answer. A fresh question helps, but endless reconsideration can leave you without a working decision. Clarity benefits from a concrete continuation: what is now known, and which single agreement can it refine? Awakening then has somewhere to go beyond the next surprising explanation.
